up: Retrieve exact IC50 values (standard_relation='=', standard_units='nM') for compounds tested against the human target CHEMBL344 (pref_name='Melanin-concentrating hormone receptor 1'). Return the following columns: molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, target_pref_name, standard_value. Filter for rows where standard_type='IC50' and standard_relation='='. Ensure the target is Homo sapiens. Only include rows where canonical_smiles is not null AND (pubmed_id is not null OR doi is not null).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_key, COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name, a.standard_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND td.pref_name = 'Melanin-concentrating hormone receptor 1' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
